time.title: Time machine
time.resetConfirm: Reset the demo? Notifications, automatic badges, claims, shares, aliases and opt-outs are deleted and the clock goes back to the launch date.
time.ran: Processed {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} up to {to}: {awards} new badges, {notifications} notifications.

errors.notForward: That is already the demo date.

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Where the program stands on the demo date.

import.title: Import data
import.subtitle: Upload the donations file (cumulative: every donation so far) and the subscriptions file (a fresh snapshot). You see what would change before anything is saved.
import.optional: Either file can be left out.
import.previewTitle: Preview: nothing has been saved yet
import.skipNote: Rows with problems are skipped; the valid rows are imported.

errors.noFiles: Choose at least one CSV file.
errors.expired: The preview expired. Upload the files again.
errors.failed: The import failed. Check the files and try again.

import.never: No import has been run from here yet.
import.after: New history rows do not create notifications retroactively. Use Reset demo to recompute everything from the data.

posts.subtitle: Bilingual content for the donors' feed. A campaign adds a goal, dates and a progress bar.
posts.campaignSlugHelp: Donations tagged with this slug count towards the goal, e.g. emergencia-sismo-2026.
posts.publishedAtHelp: Leave empty for the demo date. Posts dated today or earlier notify donors right away.
posts.deleteConfirm: Delete this post and its notifications?

atRisk.subtitle: Recurring donors whose payments are failing, with what they stand to lose. A good list for the team to follow up.
atRisk.empty: No recurring donor is at risk right now.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Every number the engine uses. Changes apply to the days still to be processed.
settings.readOnly: Launch date {launch} · demo date {today}. The clock is moved with the time machine.

points.label: Impact Points
points.help: Points per dollar (one-time, recurring, matched), the streak bonus and the engagement points with their monthly caps.

recurringTiers.label: Recurring tiers
recurringTiers.help: Minimum monthly amount (USD) for each recurring tier.

graceDays.label: Grace period (days)
graceDays.help: Days a failed payment can be fixed before the streak resets.

failureWindowDaysMonthly.label: Failure window, monthly (days)
failureWindowDaysMonthly.help: Days without a successful charge before a monthly plan counts as failing.

gapNudgeThresholdUsd.label: Gap nudge threshold (USD)
gapNudgeThresholdUsd.help: "You're only $X from #N" is sent when the gap is at most this.

gapNudgeCooldownDays.label: Gap nudge cooldown (days)
gapNudgeCooldownDays.help: Minimum days between those messages for the same ranking.

rankDownCooldownDays.label: Rank-down cooldown (days)
rankDownCooldownDays.help: Minimum days between "someone passed you" notifications. 0 sends every move.

nextMilestoneNudgePct.label: Near-milestone nudge (%)
nextMilestoneNudgePct.help: How close to a badge or tier (in %) before a nudge is sent.

lapsedMonths.label: Lapsed donor (months)
lapsedMonths.help: Months without a donation before the "we miss you" message.

matchingReminderMonthDay.label: Matching reminder date
matchingReminderMonthDay.help: Day of the year (MM-DD) to remind everyone about employer matching.

earlyAdopterDays.label: Early Adopter window (days)
earlyAdopterDays.help: A first login within this many days of launch earns the Early Adopter badge.

orgMilestones.label: Organisation milestones (USD)
orgMilestones.help: Totals that trigger "together we passed $X". A JSON list in increasing order.

impactEquivalences.label: Impact equivalences
impactEquivalences.help: Placeholder "≈" lines: dollars per unit and its text key. The first one is used in notifications.

Matching.title: Matching gifts
Matching.subtitle: Many employers match what their employees donate, so your gift can double.
Matching.step2: Send a matching request through your employer's giving portal, often Benevity or Double the Donation.
Matching.step3: Your employer matches your gift and you earn the Double Impact badge.
Matching.none: No result for “{query}”. Ask your HR team whether your company uses Double the Donation or Benevity.
Matching.ddt: Double the Donation: search your company
Matching.benevity: Benevity: what it is and how it works
Matching.hr: Many people don't know their company has a matching program. Ask HR, or look for “Benevity” in your employee benefits portal.

Profile.title: My profile
Profile.subtitle: Your preferences, the accounts you follow and your invitation link.
Profile.aliasHelp: Shown on your share cards instead of your username. Leave it empty to use {username}.
Profile.optOut: Hide the gamification (rankings, badges and activity)
Profile.optOutHelp: If you turn this on you only see your donations and this profile, and you stop receiving ranking and badge notifications. Your donations are never affected.
Profile.socialHelp: Follow AlumnUSB and let us know. A team member confirms it, and you earn a badge and engagement points.
Profile.referralHelp: Share your personal link. When a friend you invited makes their first donation, you earn the Recruiter badge.
Profile.invited: {n, plural, one {# friend has donated} other {# friends have donated}} through your link.
